use: a line of code changing state, from a code file
request: Here's the code from my lesson file. Make a short that explains how this loop finds the biggest number, for beginners.

material.name: biggest.js
material.about: the code file from the user's lesson

topic: How a loop finds the biggest number
intent: Beginners learning JavaScript need to see a variable change as a loop runs.
goal: The viewer can follow the variable best through each pass of the loop and say why it ends at 7.
promise: A tiny program and one variable to watch.
arc: The code with best at 0, the first pass slowly, a guess, the rest quickly, ending on the printed 7.

events.text: Here's a tiny program that finds the biggest number. Watch the variable called best.
events.job: Show the program and point at the one variable to watch.
events.knows: best is the variable that tracks the answer.
events.look: the code, and the variable best

events.text: It starts at zero. The loop takes three. Three beats zero, so best becomes three.
events.job: First pass of the loop, slowly.
events.look: the lit line and best changing from 0 to 3

holds.does: the program waits; the list still shows 7 coming next
holds.shows: Next is 7. What happens to best?

phases.why: the first pass, one line at a time

events.text: Seven beats three, so best is seven. Two doesn't beat seven, so nothing changes.
events.job: The rest of the loop, quicker.

events.text: At the end, best holds the biggest number: seven.

quiz.q: What value does best start at?
What list does the loop go through?

quiz.a: Nothing changes: 2 doesn't beat 7, so best stays 7.

quiz.q: Which line of the program is the one that changes best?
quiz.a: The if line: if (x > best) best = x.
